args.message:
Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in round_money per FIN-212

The docstring and tests require banker's rounding
(ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212, but the implementation
used ROUND_HALF_UP. Fixed the rounding mode so
2.665 rounds to 2.66 as expected.

args.head: fix/money-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary

`round_money` in `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` even though its docstring, FIN-212, and the test suite require banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This caused `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` to fail in the nightly build because `2.665` rounded to `2.67` instead of `2.66`.

## Changes

- Replaced `ROUND_HALF_UP` with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in the rounding call in `src/money.py`.
- No behavioral changes to the API surface; the docstring already described the correct behavior.

## Validation

- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986`: **passed** (nightly test suite now green).
- Manual check: `round_money(Decimal("2.675")) == 2.68`, `round_money(Decimal("2.665")) == 2.66`.

Fixes the nightly build failure and unblocks today's release.
